name: gedik
description: Finds breaches (GEDIK) by breaking your own code, artifacts, and configuration like an attacker. First measures the architecture (triage T1-T12), then opens only that surface: A client/mobile · B server/API/DB/identity · C BaaS-RLS · D AI/LLM · E shipped artifact; plus code review, mechanical scanning, dependency/CVE, CI-CD and test-suite mutation. Every finding ships with a working PoC; what isn't measured isn't assumed clean. Read-only; your own project only.
